concurrency_and_state: Static global mutable state across client systems: Hint (all coordinates/flags static), ItemTime.autoUseIconIds/lastTimeCheckAutoUse (static HashSet/long not cleared on logout/char switch), ImgByName.hashImagePath (static MyHashTable), ItemTemplates.itemTemplates (static MyHashTable), Info._gocnhon/lastZoomGocNhon (static cached texture), InfoMe.me (static singleton), MapTemplate static arrays, Key static keycode mappings.
Info_RadaScr.paintEff (Info_RadaScr.cs:263-291) mutates eff (MyVector) by calling SetEff() and eff.removeElementAt(i) during paint().

InfoMe.update (InfoMe.cs:142-314) and Info.update (Info.cs:229-247) mutate infoWaitToShow and InfoItem timers on the main Unity update thread; Info.paint (Info.cs:96-101) mutates cx/cy directly when outSide == true.
No locks or multithreading primitives present in this batch; all classes run on the Unity main loop except session callbacks via IMessageHandler/ISession.
cross_module_questions: Verify in Service.cs / Controller.cs how getImgByName, useItem, login, login2, requestRegister, getMagicTree, and magicTree serialize/deserialize payloads and whether bag indexUI > 127 can occur with (sbyte)targetItem.indexUI in ItemTime.triggerAutoUse.
Verify in GameScr/ServerEffect/PopUp whether Info.outSide == true is ever used in a context where Info.paint mutating cx/cy causes frame-over-frame coordinate drift.

Verify in Service/Char how ItemTemplates placeholders created by ItemTemplates.get (ItemTemplates.cs:15-19) interact with real item template loading and whether missing templates get overwritten properly.
Check GameCanvas/Menu/Panel interaction with LoginScr.paint overwriting tfUser/tfPass/cmdLogin/cmdBackFromRegister coordinates every frame and ignoring cmdMenu/cmdRes/cmdFogetPass.

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Local client persistent cache (not DB/Redis). Keyed by zoomLevel + 'ImgByName_' + nameImg; corrupt RMS bytes caught and logged via Debug.LogError.
Local client persistent settings (acc, pass, check, indServer, userAo/passAo, lowGraphic, IP). Passwords use saveRMSPassword/loadRMSPassword.

findings.impact: Horizontal scroll fling velocity is computed from stale pointer history on touch-down, causing erratic horizontal scrolling/flicks in ListNew.
findings.root_cause: updatePos_LEFT_RIGHT initializes pointerDownLastX[0] inside the loop instead of pointerDownLastX[i] (unlike update_Pos_UP_DOWN at line 147).
findings.title: Wrong array index in ListNew.updatePos_LEFT_RIGHT pointer history init

findings.impact: DivideByZeroException when maxPeas == 0, and IndexOutOfRangeException/NullReferenceException when isPeasEffect runs with currPeas <= 0 or null peaPostionX.
findings.root_cause: Line 146 divides by maxPeas without checking maxPeas > 0; line 174 indexes peaPostionX[currPeas - 1] without null or bounds checks on currPeas and peaPostionX.
findings.title: Unchecked division by zero and array bounds in MagicTree.update

findings.impact: Dropped item does not animate smoothly from (x, y) to (xEnd, yEnd) because it starts already at xEnd and overshoots; debug log prints playerId before assignment.
findings.root_cause: Constructor assigns this.x = xEnd instead of this.x = x while computing vx = xEnd - x >> 2, and logs playerId at line 75 before assigning it.
findings.title: ItemMap constructor initializes x to xEnd instead of x

findings.impact: NullReferenceException if GameCanvas.lowGraphic is toggled from true to false while an aura ItemMap exists on map.
findings.root_cause: setAuraItem() skips allocating xArg/yArg/xDot/yDot when GameCanvas.lowGraphic is true, while paintAuraItemEff iterates yArg.Length whenever lowGraphic becomes false.
findings.title: Uninitialized aura dot arrays when lowGraphic toggles in ItemMap

findings.impact: Buff countdown timer skips/jumps to 60s when second hits 0 (e.g., 60s input ticks to 0'60s), and negative/infinite text timers (time == -1) decrement minute unboundedly.
findings.root_cause: update() checks if (second <= 0) { second = 60; minute--; } instead of resetting to 59 when second < 0, and does not skip countdown when dontClear is true.
findings.title: ItemTime countdown second reset off-by-one and infinite timer decrement

findings.impact: Auto-use buff settings persist across character/account switches within the same client session, and bag slot index > 127 overflows sbyte cast in useItem call.
findings.root_cause: autoUseIconIds is a static HashSet<short> never cleared on logout/switch; triggerAutoUse casts targetItem.indexUI to (sbyte).
findings.title: ItemTime static autoUseIconIds leaks across characters and casts indexUI to sbyte

findings.impact: Per-frame heap allocations in Unity render/update loops increase GC pauses on mobile/PC clients.
findings.root_cause: Info.paint calls Res.split/splitFontArray every frame; ItemTime.paint/paintText and LoginScr.paint concatenate strings every frame; MagicTree.update calls NinjaUtil.getTime(seconds) every frame; Info_RadaScr.paintEff allocates Position via SetEff inside paint.
findings.title: Per-frame allocations and string concatenations in paint() and update() loops

findings.impact: If Info.outSide is true, speech bubble position drifts by (-cmx, -cmy + 35) on every paint frame; duplicate info messages are not filtered.
findings.root_cause: Info.paint directly mutates cx and cy when outSide is true; Info.addInfo has an empty if-block stub where duplicate-message filtering should return.
findings.title: Info.paint mutates cx/cy when outSide is true and Info.addInfo has empty dedup stub

findings.impact: NullReferenceException if Item.getUpMax() or Item.isUpMax() is called on an Item with null template.
findings.root_cause: getUpMax() accesses template.level directly without a null check, unlike isTypeBody() and getUpgradestring().
findings.title: Missing null check on Item.template in getUpMax()

findings.impact: Copied Item loses temp appearance parts, consignor name, purchase specs, and comparison metadata when clone() is used.
findings.root_cause: Item.clone() omits fields including quantilyToBuy, powerRequire, buySpec, buyRuby, iconSpec, buyType, isBuySpec, headTemp/bodyTemp/legTemp/bagTemp/wpTemp, nameNguoiKyGui, info, content, reason.
findings.title: Incomplete field copying in Item.clone()

findings.impact: Dead/unreachable tutorial hint code and dead LoginScr methods/UI state cause confusion and double-update overhead.
findings.root_cause: Hint.hint() returns early for taskId > 2 making case 3 and taskId == 9 blocks unreachable; LoginScr.getServerLink creates an unused Command; LoginScr.update updates tfUser/tfPass twice per tick and conflicts with updateKey/paint over command/layout assignments.
findings.title: Unreachable Hint branches, dead LoginScr code, and duplicated tfUser/tfPass updates

findings.impact: Missing bounds/null checks on SmallImage.smallImg[id] and uninitialized placeholder caching in ItemTemplates.get.
findings.root_cause: MagicTree indexes SmallImage.smallImg[id][3]/[4] directly; ItemTemplates.get caches a synthetic 'Item <id>' template on cache miss.
findings.title: Unchecked SmallImage array indexing in MagicTree and placeholder caching in ItemTemplates

findings.impact: Incorrect alpha channel (255f instead of 1f) and 256f divisor in mLine.setColor.
findings.root_cause: r/g/b are normalized to [0, 1) via /256f while a is set to 255f.
findings.title: Inconsistent color normalization in mLine.setColor

module_summary: Client Game1 gameplay entities, UI widgets/screens, input/network interfaces, and item/aura/hint/login models (42 files, 5961 lines). Covers item models (Item, ItemMap, ItemOption, ItemTemplate, ItemTemplates, ItemTime, ItemObject), UI/HUD info & scrolling (Hint, Info, InfoItem, InfoMe, Info_RadaScr, InfoPhuBan, InputDlg, ListNew, LoginScr, MagicTree), image/map/math helpers (ImgByName, ImageInfo, MainImage, MapTemplate, Math, Member, Line, mLine, Layer), input/platform wrappers (Key, KeyConstant, ipKeyboard, iOSPlugins, iPhoneGeneration, iPhoneSettings), and core interfaces (HTTPHandler, IActionListener, IChatable, IKbAction, IMapObject, IMessageHandler, IPaint, ISession, InputStream).
